αἰδοίη: αἰδοῖος — held in respect, revered; fem. nom. sg. · also fem. voc. sg., in address: ’revered one’ (ὦ γύναι αἰδοίη)
αἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj., epic/dialectal by-form αἰ (used before κε)
αἴθοπα: αἴθοψ — fire-faced, sparkling (of wine, lit. αἴθω ’burn’ + ὤψ ’face’); masc. acc. sg. · also of smoke, masc. acc. sg. (αἴθοπα καπνόν ’fiery smoke’)
αὐτή: αὐτός — self; fem. nom. sg., intensive, stressing the subject herself: ’(you) yourself’ · also intensive, 1st person: ’I myself’ (αὐτή μιν πόμπευον ’I myself escorted him’)
αὐτοῖς: αὐτός — self; masc. dat. pl., intensive with σφίσι: ’for themselves’ · also intensive with a noun, masc. dat. pl.: αὐτοῖς ὀβελοῖσιν ’the very spits’
αὐτοῦ: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (ἑὸν αὐτοῦ ’his own very own’): ’of himself’ · also the fixed adv. αὐτοῦ, ’there, on the spot, right here’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’, governed by a preposition: ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ’from him’ · also intensive with a noun, masc. gen. sg.: ’Alcinous himself’ (αὐτοῦ Ἀλκινόοιο) · also reflexive intensive gen. sg. after a personal pronoun: σέο τ’ αὐτοῦ ’and of yourself’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun of a thing, ’from it’, after ἐκ (ἐκ δ’ αὐτοῦ πείρατ’ ἀνήφθω, of the mast) · also masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive sense, ’his own’: αὐτοῦ ἐνεύναιον ’his own bedding’, αὐτοῦ βώτορες ’his own herdsmen’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun with a noun, ’his’: ὀστέα δ’ αὐτοῦ ’and his bones’ · also intensive gen. sg. with a demonstrative and noun: τοῦδ’ αὐτοῦ λυκάβαντος ’this very year’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun of a thing, ’upon it’, after ἐπί (ἐπ’ αὐτοῦ, of a stool)
αὐτὴν: αὐτός — self; fem. acc. sg.: ’her’ · also intensive, accusative subject of an infinitive: ’she herself’ (αὐτὴν ποθέσαι ’that she herself miss [him]’) · also attributive, ’the same’: τῷ αὐτὴν ὁδὸν ’the very same road’ · also intensive with a noun, ’very’: εἰς ὁδὸν αὐτὴν ’into the very path’ · also intensive with a pronoun object, ’you yourself’ (σὲ … αὐτήν)
αὐτῷ: αὐτός — self; masc. dat. sg.: ’himself’, reinforcing a personal pronoun (σοὶ δ’ αὐτῷ ’to you yourself’) · also used alone as a plain personal pronoun, ’him’, not reinforcing anything (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ μηχανόωνται ’are plotting against him’) · also with a noun, ’own, very’, in the dat. of accompaniment: αὐτῷ φάρει ’with the cloak itself, cloak and all’ · also reinforcing a 1st-person pronoun: ’myself’ (ἐμοὶ αὐτῷ) · also plain pronoun of a thing, ’it’, after a preposition (ἀμφ’ αὐτῷ ’around it’)
βίον: βίος — life, way of living; masc. acc. sg.
βίοτον: βίοτος — life, livelihood, substance one lives on; acc. sg.
βασίλευε: βασιλεύω — be king, rule; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐβασίλευε)
βασιλῆος: βασιλεύς — king; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
βορέης: Βορέας — the North Wind, personified; epic nom. sg. Βορέης (= Attic Βορέας)
βοῦς: βοῦς — ox, cow; pl. ’cattle’; acc. pl. · also masc./fem. nom. sg. (same spelling as the acc. pl.): ’the ox, the heifer’ (ἦλθε ... βοῦς ’the heifer came’)
γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γένος: γένος — stock, race, lineage, offspring; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., governed by μετά: ’after (blood and) lineage’ · also neut. acc. sg., object of εὔχομαι: ’descent, birth’ (γένος εὔχομαι ’I declare my birth’) · also neut. acc. sg. of respect: ’by birth’ (ἐξ Ἰθάκης γένος εἰμί ’I am of Ithaca by birth’)
γήμασθ: γαμέω — marry; aor. inf. mid., elided (γήμασθ’ = γήμασθαι), of a woman, used as an imperative: ’marry!’
γαίῃ: γαῖα — earth, ground; fem. dat. sg.
γαῖα: γαῖα — earth, land; fem. nom. sg. (epic = Attic γῆ)
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γενεῇ: γενεή — birth, lineage, descent; fem. dat. sg.: ’by birth’
γόνον: γόνος — birth, offspring, begetting, stock; acc. sg.
γύναι: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. voc. sg.: ’wife’ · also fem. voc. sg., plain address to a woman who is not a wife: ’woman’ (χαῖρε, γύναι ’be glad, woman’)
δέμας: δέμας — bodily form, frame; neut. acc. sg., accusative of respect: ’in body’ · also neut. acc. sg., direct object or in apposition: ’body’ (εἶδός τε δέμας τε ’form and body’)
δένδρεα: δένδρεον — tree; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic δένδρα)
δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δίκη: δίκη — custom, right, the way things are done; fem. nom. sg.
δαίμων: δαίμων — a god, some divine power (vague, unspecified); masc. nom. sg.
δημιοεργοὶ: δημιοεργός — craftsman working for the community (δῆμος + ἔργον); masc. nom. pl. (Attic δημιουργός)
διὰ: διά — through, throughout; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: διὰ … τινάξῃ = διατινάξῃ ’shake apart, shatter’ · also + acc., causal, ’through, thanks to, by the aid of’ (διὰ … Ἀθήνην) · also as adverb/preverb in tmesis with κοσμηθέντες (διὰ … κοσμηθέντες = διακοσμηθέντες ’drawn up in divisions’) · also + gen., ’through, among’ (διὰ μήλων ’among the flocks’) · also prep. + gen., ’through’ (διὰ πτόλιος ’through the city’)
δμῳάς: δμῳή — female slave, maidservant (Attic δούλη); fem. acc. pl.
δουλιχίῳ: Δουλίχιον — Dulichium, an island near Ithaca (exact location unknown); dat. sg.
δυώδεκα: δώδεκα — twelve; indeclinable numeral, epic δυώδεκα (= Attic δώδεκα)
δόλους: δόλος — guile, trick, cunning device; masc. acc. pl.
δύναμαι: δύναμαι — be able, can; pres. 1 sg.
δώματ: δῶμα — house, home; neut. acc. pl., elided (δώματ’ = δώματα) · also neut. nom. pl., subject: κλυτὰ δώματ’ ἔασιν ’his famous halls are’
δῆμον: δῆμος — people, land, community; masc. acc. sg.
δῖοι: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. nom. pl. δῖοι, here extended to the Achaeans generally (δῖοι Ἀχαιοί) rather than a single hero
δῖος: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. nom. sg., epithet of heroes (= fem. δῖα)
δῶκα: δίδωμι — give; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἔδωκα)
εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also introducing an indirect question after a verb of asking or telling: ’whether’ (εἰ δή ’whether indeed’) · also in εἰ δ’ ἄγε, an interjectional idiom with the imperative: ’come now, well then’ · also with opt., in a wish: ’if only’ (εἰ … ὁμοφρονέοις … γένοιο) · also ὡς εἰ + opt., ’as if’ (ὡς εἰ … ἱκοίατο ’as if they had come’)
εἰμὶ: εἰμί — be; pres. 1 sg. (grave, mid-clause form): ’I am’
εἰπὲ: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. imper. 2 sg.
εἰρήσομαι: εἴρομαι — ask, question; fut. 1 sg. mid., epic (= Attic ἐρήσομαι)
εἰς: εἰς — into, to; prep. + acc. · also εἰμί ’be’: pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ): ’you are’ (τίς … εἰς; ’who are you?’) · also in the idiom εἰς ὅ (κε) ’until’: εἰς ὅ κεν … μιγήῃς ’until you mingle with’
εἰσανέβαινον: εἰσαναβαίνω — go up into, march up into; impf. 3 pl., augmented (εἰσ-αν-έ-βαινον; the α of ἀνα- elides before the augment)
εἴα: ἐάω — allow, permit; impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’allowed’
εἴη: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 3 sg.: ’it might be, he might be’; impersonal + inf.: ’it might be possible for him’ · also in a wish with a dat. of the person: ’may there be (for us)’ (εἴη μὲν νῦν νῶϊν … ἐδωδὴ ’may there be food for us two’) · also in a wish after εἰ γάρ, ’if only (all things) were’ · also in a fear clause after μή, ’lest it be (a god)’ · also in a conditional protasis: ’if he were’ (εἰ τοιόσδ’ εἴη) · also in an indirect question after a past verb: ’who he was’ (τίς εἴη) · also in a negative wish with μή, ’may (no man) be’ · also potential opt. with κε in a relative clause, ’which would be’ (τό κε κέρδιον εἴη ’which would be better’)
εἴλει: εἴλω (εἰλέω) — shut in, pen up; impf. 3 sg.: ’was shutting in’
εἶδός: εἶδος — form, appearance, beauty; neut. acc. sg.; accented before enclitic τε
εἶς: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ): ’you are’
εὐδείελον: εὐδείελος — clear-seen or sunny (sense disputed); adj. of two terminations, fem. acc. sg., epithet of Ithaca
εὐρὺν: εὐρύς — broad, wide; masc. acc. sg.
ζακύνθῳ: Ζάκυνθος — Zacynthus, an island near Ithaca; dat. sg.
ζεὺς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
θάνε: θνῄσκω — die; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔθανε)
θανάτοιο: θάνατος — death; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
θυμόν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg. · also the life that leaves the body: ’life’ (μελέων ἐξείλετο θυμόν ’took the life out of the limbs’)
θυμὸν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg. · also the life that leaves the body: ’life’ (μελιηδέα θυμὸν ἀπηύρα ’took away (my) honey-sweet life’)
θυμὸς: θυμός — heart, spirit, desire; nom. sg.
κάκιον: κακός — bad, evil; comparative κακίων, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’worse’
κάλλιον: καλός — good, fine, fair; comparative κάλλιον, neut. nom./acc. sg. used predicatively: ’better, finer’
κέν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · also + aor. indic., unreal past: κέν μοι … κατέχευας ’you would have poured on me’ · also + subj. in a main clause: ’may’ (καί κέν οἱ ὑπέρσχῃ χεῖρα ’and he may hold his hand over him’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (κέν μοι … εἴη ’would be mine’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κέν τις … ὀρέξῃ ’if perhaps someone holds out’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κέν … μεταλλῶσιν ’whenever they ask’) · also + opt., potential, in a clause with ὅ ’that’: ’might’ (ὅ κέν τις … ἀμύνοι ’that someone might defend’)
κήδεσθαι: κήδομαι — care for, be concerned about (+ gen.); pres. inf. mid.
καθέλῃσι: καθαιρέω — take down, bring down; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic ending -ῃσι (= Attic καθέλῃ)
κακὰ: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. nom. pl., subject: κακὰ ἔργα ’bad deeds’
καλὴ: καλός — beautiful, fair; fem. nom. sg.
καρπῷ: καρπός — wrist; masc. dat. sg. (distinct from καρπός ’fruit’)
κατήγαγεν: κατάγω — lead down, bring down; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’brought down’
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, in; prep. + acc.; also as preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἤσθιον = κατήσθιον ’devoured’) · also ’according to, in conformity with’ (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’) · also + acc., ’in quest of, after’ (κατὰ ληίδα ’in quest of plunder’) · also + gen., ’down from’ (κατὰ πετράων ’down from the rocks’) · also + gen., ’all over, throughout’ (κατὰ σπείους κέχυτο ’lay spread all over the cave’) · also + acc., of the part grasped: ’by’ (κατὰ νῶτα λαβών ’taking him by the back’) · also + acc., ’on account of, on the business of’ (κατὰ χρέος ’on business’) · also + gen., ’down in, within’ (κατὰ σπείους κοίλοιο δέδυκεν ’is sunk in the hollow cave’)
κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κε … ἐποτρύνῃ ’until … urges on’) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὅς κε πίῃ) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever, as soon as’ (ὅτε … κε θάνῃσιν; ἐπεί κε … λίπῃ) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κε … ἀκούσῃς) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ δέ κε λίσσηαι ’but if you beg’) · also + aor. indic., unreal past: ’would have’ (καὶ νύ κε … βάλεν ’and she would have hurled’) · also + subj. in a disjunctive statement of what may happen: ’may’ (ἤ κε θάνωμεν ’either we may die’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (καί κε … μαχοίμην ’I would fight’) · also + subj. in a relative clause of purpose: ’who are to’ (οἵ κε … ἀγγείλωσι ’who are to announce’) · also + fut. indic. (or short-vowel subj.) in a main clause: ’will’ (αἶψά κε … ἀποτίσεται ’at once he will exact payment’) · also + aor. in a general relative clause: ’who would (decide)’ (οἵ κε … ἔκριναν)
κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + secondary indic. (κατέφθιτο), unreal past conditional: ’would have perished’ · also + aor. indic. of a future event pictured as already accomplished, an eventual near-certainty rather than a counterfactual: ἤ κεν ... κτεῖνεν ’or he may well have killed (him) already’ · also + subj. in a relative clause, prospective: ’who is to, who will’ (ἥ κεν ἄγῃσι ’(a wagon) that shall carry’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κεν … δαινύῃ ’whenever you feast’) · also + subj. in the protasis of a condition after αἴ: ’if ever’ · also + opt., potential: ’might, may’ · also + opt. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ δέ κεν … ἀφικοίμεθα ’but if we should reach’) · also + fut. indic. or short-vowel subj. in an apodosis: ’will’ (αἶψά κεν … τεύξομεν ’at once we will build’) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἴ κεν … ἵκωμαι ’if I should come’) · also + subj. in a disjunctive statement of what may happen: ’may’ (ἤ κεν ἁλώῃ ’or he may be caught’) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὅς κεν ὀπυίῃ ’whoever marries’) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν ἔλθω ’until I come’) · also + fut. indic. in a main clause or an indirect disjunctive question: ’shall’ (ἤ κεν … δυνησόμεθ’ ’whether we shall be able’) · also + fut. indic. in a relative clause: ’who will’ (ὅς κεν … ἐποίσει ’who will lay on’) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κεν … καταθείομαι ’so that I may put away’)
κεῖνός: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. nom. sg.
κεῖται: κεῖμαι — lie; pres. 3 sg., used of the dead: ’lies (dead)’ · also in the idiom θεῶν ἐν γούνασι κεῖται: ’rests with the gods, lies in the gods’ hands’ (of an outcome, not of the dead) · also subj. (= κέηται): ’should lie’ · also plain pres. 3 sg. of stored objects: ’lies, is kept/stored’ (κειμήλια κεῖται ’treasures lie stored’) · also pres. 3 sg. of a living person in a settled, ongoing state, not of the dead nor of an outcome nor of stored goods (ὁ μὲν ἐν νήσῳ κεῖται ’πάσχων’): ’remains, is stranded, dwells on’ · also of a place, ’lies, is situated’ (νῆσος ... κεῖται ’an island lies’) · also of an object: ’lies’ (ἀράχνια κεῖται ἔχουσα ’lies holding cobwebs’)
κηρύκων: κῆρυξ — herald; masc. gen. pl., partitive: ’of the heralds’
κλέος: κλέος — fame, renown, report; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. (same form), direct object: μέγα κλέος ἤρατο ’won great fame’; κλέος φέρειν ’bring report’
κλυτὸν: κλυτός — famous, renowned, glorious; masc. acc. sg.
κοῦροι: κοῦρος — young man, boy; nom. pl.
κτεατίσσας: κτεατίζω — acquire, gain possession of; aor. part. masc. nom. sg., epic double σ (κτεατίσσας)
κύδωνες: Κύδωνες — the Cydonians, a people of western Crete; masc. nom. pl.
κύνας: κύων — dog; masc./fem. acc. pl. (of sea creatures, perhaps dogfish)
κῦδος: κῦδος — glory, the lustre of success granted by a god; neut. nom./acc. sg.
λαέρτῃ: Λαέρτης — Laertes, father of Odysseus; masc. dat. sg.
λαερτιάδεω: Λαερτιάδης — son of Laertes; masc. gen. sg., epic -εω (= Attic -ου), a patronymic of Odysseus
λαοὶ: λαός — people, host, men of the community; masc. nom. pl.
λεπτὸν: λεπτός — fine, thin, delicate; masc./neut. acc. sg.
μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.)
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μάλιστα: μάλα — very, much; superl. adv. μάλιστα: ’most of all, especially’ · also ’for the most part, mostly’ (μάλιστα ἦμαρ ’the greater part of the day’)
μέγαν: μέγας — great, big, tall; masc. acc. sg.
μέγας: μέγας — great, big, grown; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’grown’ · also plain attributive adj., masc. nom. sg., ’great, huge’ (μέγας σῦς ’a great boar’), not predicate
μέλαινα: μέλας — black, dark; fem. nom. sg.
μέν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ (the acute μέν is kept before a following enclitic; elsewhere μὲν) · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’ (οὐ μέν ’not indeed’) · also μένω — stay, wait; pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (μέν’ = μένε): ’stay’
μένον: μένω — wait, wait for; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented · also impf. 1 sg. (same form), intransitive: ’I remained, stayed’
μέσῳ: μέσος — middle, in the middle of; masc./neut. dat. sg., agreeing with πόντῳ: ’in the middle of the sea’ · also used alone as a noun, ’in the middle’ (ἐν μέσῳ ’in the middle’)
μή: μή — not; negative particle (used with imperatives and subjunctives, unlike οὐ) · also introducing a negative purpose/fear clause with the optative in secondary sequence: μή ἑ λάθοι ’lest he should escape notice’ · also μή + fut. inf. after a verb of swearing/promising, negating its content: μή ... βουλευσέμεν ’that ... will not plan’ · also ’lest’ with the subj. after a primary verb (μή πώς ... χαλεπήνῃ ’lest he be harsh’) · also in a question expecting the answer ’no’, after ἦ: ἦ μή … φάσθ’ ἔμμεναι; ’surely you do not say … are?’ · also ’lest’ + subj. after a past verb of urging (κελόμην … μή … λάθηται ’I urged … lest he forget’) · also in a condition, ’if … not’ (εἰ … μή τίς σε βιάζεται) · also with an infinitive used as an imperative, a prohibition: μή μ’ … καταλείπειν ’do not leave me’ · also negating a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’so that … not’ (ἵνα μή τι … ἀλγήσετε ’so that you may not suffer’) · also with the optative, a negative wish: ’may … not’ (μή … ἀντιβολήσαις) · also ὡς ἂν μή + subj., negative purpose: ’so that … not’ (ὡς ἂν μή σε κατατρύχῃ ’so that he may not wear you out’) · also + subj. giving the content of an oath, ’that no one …’ (ὀμόσσατε … μή τις … πλήξῃ ’swear that no one strike’) · also μή + subj. standing alone as a warning, ’lest’ (μή τίς τοι … ἀναστῇ ’lest someone rise up against you’)
μίμνετ: μένω — wait, stay, abide; pres. imper. 2 pl., reduplicated stem μίμνω, elided (μίμνετ’ = μίμνετε)
μεγάλη: μέγας — great, large; fem. nom. sg.
μεγάροισιν: μέγαρον — hall, great room, house; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν), plural for a single house
μεγαθύμου: μεγάθυμος — great-hearted, high-spirited; masc. gen. sg.
μεταλλᾷς: μεταλλάω — inquire after, ask about; pres. 2 sg.
μεταμώνια: μεταμώνιος — wasted, vain, gone to the winds; neut. nom. pl.
μετὰ: μετά — among, with, after; prep. + dat./acc./gen. · with acc. also ’in quest of, in search of’ (μετὰ χαλκόν ’after bronze’) · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’ · also adverb, ’among them, in their midst’: μετὰ δὲ πρέπει ἀγρομένοισιν ’and he stands out among the gathered’ · also as preverb in tmesis (μετὰ … βεβήκει = μεταβεβήκει ’had moved on, passed on’) · also a plain adverb, ’afterwards’ (μετὰ γάρ τε καὶ ἄλγεσι τέρπεται ἀνήρ ’for afterwards a man takes pleasure even in pains’; some take it as ’among’ with ἄλγεσι) · also + dat. of the mind, ’in’ (μετὰ φρεσὶ σῇσι ’in your mind’)
μεῖζον: μείζων — greater, larger; neut. nom./acc. sg., comparative of μέγας
μηδ: μηδέ — and not, nor; neg. conj., elided (μηδ’ = μηδέ)
μηνῶν: μείς (epic μήν) — month; masc. gen. pl., in a gen. absolute with φθινόντων
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μνηστῆρες: μνηστήρ — suitor; nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’suitors!’
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’ · also dat. of the person affected, ’from my …’ (μοι βλεφάρων ἐξέσσυτο ὕπνος ’sleep rushed out from my eyelids’) · also dat. of possession with εἰμί: ’who are mine’ (οἵ μοι ἔασιν ’who are mine’)
μοῖρ: μοῖρα — fate, portion, lot; fem. nom. sg., elided (μοῖρ’ = μοῖρα)
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
μᾶλλον: μάλα — very, much; comparative adv. μᾶλλον: ’more, rather, the more’
μῆλα: μῆλον — sheep, goat, flock-animal; neut. nom. pl.: ’the flocks’ · also neut. acc. pl. (same form), direct object: ἦγον ... μῆλα ’they led sheep’
μῆτιν: μῆτις — cunning intelligence, craft, counsel; fem. acc. sg.
νήεσσι: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. pl., epic νήεσσι (= Attic ναυσί)
νήματ: νῆμα — thread, spun yarn; neut. nom. pl., elided (νήματ’ = νήματα)
νήσοισιν: νῆσος — island; dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οις)
νεμεσήσῃ: νεμεσάω — feel righteous indignation; aor. subj. 3 sg.
νηυσὶ: ναῦς — ship; dat. pl., epic νηυσί (= Attic ναυσί)
νύκτας: νύξ — night; fem. acc. pl., acc. of time: ’by nights’
ξείνια: ξείνιος (Attic ξένιος) — of or for a guest; τὰ ξείνια as noun, gifts and entertainment due to a guest; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ξείνων: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend; masc. gen. pl.: ’of the strangers’ · also partitive gen. after a vocative: ’among strangers, of strangers’ (δαιμόνιε ξείνων ’strange one among guests’)
ξεῖν: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend; voc. sg., elided (ξεῖν’ = ξεῖνε)
ξεῖνε: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); voc. sg.
ξεῖνον: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); acc. sg.
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (very common) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό ’he, she, it’, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ (e.g. οἱ μὲν … οἱ δέ ’some … others’) · also encl. dat. sg. fem. ’to/for her’ (ἥ οἱ ὁμηλικίη ’who was of an age with her’) · also article-like with a numeral and noun, masc. nom. pl.: ’the’ (οἱ δὲ δύω σκόπελοι ’the two crags’) · also encl. dat. sg. of a thing, ’to/for it’ (δύω δέ τέ οἱ θύραι ’and it has two doors’) · also article-like with a noun, masc. nom. pl.: ’those, the’ (οἱ πέπλοι ’the robes’) · also dat. sg. of the giver with δέχομαι: ’from him’ (οἱ ἐδέξατο ’took from him’)
οἳ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl.
οἴκου: οἶκος — house, household; masc. gen. sg.
οἴνοπι: οἶνοψ — wine-dark, wine-faced (of the sea); masc. dat. sg., agreeing with πόντῳ
οἴνῳ: οἶνος — wine; masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with wine’ (οἴνῳ βεβαρηότες ’heavy with wine’)
οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl. · also encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (= οἱ, accented οἵ in this position) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; masc. nom. pl. ’they’, demonstrative: οἵ γ’ ὑβρισταί ’are they violent?’
οἶκον: οἶκος — house, household (and its stores); acc. sg.
οἷός: οἷος — such as, of what sort; relative adj., masc. nom. sg., correlative with τοῖος: ’such as, as ... when’
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὐκέτ: οὐκέτι — no longer; adv., elided (οὐκέτ’ = οὐκέτι)
οὔθ: οὔτε (elided οὔθ’, before rough breathing) — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
οὔτ: οὔτε (elided οὔτ’) — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
οὔτε: οὔτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
οὕτως: οὕτω(ς) — so, thus, in this way; adv.
πάσχων: πάσχω — suffer, experience; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’suffering’
πάτρης: πάτρη (Attic πάτρα) — fatherland, native land; gen. sg., Ionic η for Attic ᾱ
πάϊς: παῖς — child, son; nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic παῖς)
πέλεν: πέλω — be, become; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’was’
πέσε: πίπτω — fall; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔπεσε)
παραθείμην: παρατίθημι — set beside, set before; aor. opt. mid. 1 sg., potential after κε: ’I would set before’
πατρίδα: πατρίς — native land, fatherland; fem. acc. sg. (φίλην ... πατρίδα γαῖαν ’his dear fatherland’)
πενθήμεναι: πενθέω — grieve, mourn; pres. inf., epic -ήμεναι (= Attic πενθεῖν)
περίμετρον: περίμετρος — very large, of great compass (περί ’exceedingly’ + μέτρον ’measure’); masc. acc. sg.
περίφρων: περίφρων — circumspect, of sound understanding; fem. nom. sg., stock epithet of Penelope · also epithet of Arete: fem. nom. sg., ’the circumspect queen’
περὶ: περί — around, about; prep. + gen.: ’superior to, beyond’; also as adv.: ’exceedingly, surpassingly’ · also prep. + gen. in its plain sense ’about, concerning’ (περὶ πατρός ’about his father’) · also preverb in tmesis · + dat. · also + acc., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ ἄστυ ’around the city’) · also + gen., of place, physically ’around, encircling’ (περὶ σπείους γλαφυροῖο ’around the hollow cave’), distinct from the comparative ’beyond’ sense above · also + dat. in the fixed idiom περὶ κῆρι ’exceedingly, at heart’ (περὶ κῆρι τιμήσουσιν ’will honor him at heart’) · also + dat., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ χροῒ ’about the skin’) · also adverb of place, no case: ’round about’ (περὶ δ’ ἕρκος ἐλήλαται ’and round it a fence is driven’) · also + dat., of the thing fought over: ’over, for’ (περὶ κτεάτεσσι μαχειόμενος ’fighting over possessions’)
πηνελόπεια: Πηνελόπεια — Penelope, wife of Odysseus; nom. sg.
ποθέουσα: ποθέω — long for, miss (+ acc. or gen.); pres. part. fem. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ποθοῦσα)
πολλοί: πολύς — much, many; masc. nom. pl.
πολλοῖσι: πολύς — much, many; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic πολλοῖς)
πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.: ’many things, greatly’ · also neut. nom. pl., plain attributive adj. agreeing with a neut. pl. noun (πολλὰ ... δάκρυα ’many tears’) · also neut. acc. pl., plain attributive adj. (κτήματα πολλὰ ’many possessions’) · also neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’again and again’ (πολλὰ περιτροπέοντες) · also neut. nom. pl. as substantive, subject: οἷά τε πολλὰ γίγνεται ’as many things happen’
πολύμητις: πολύμητις — of many wiles, epithet of Odysseus (built on μῆτις ’cunning intelligence’); masc. nom. sg.
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
πρότερος: πρότερος — before, first, earlier; masc. nom. sg., predicative: ’first (to)’
πρὸς: πρός — towards, against, to; prep. + acc. · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’ · also + dat.: πρὸς ἀλλήλῃσιν ἔχονται ’cling close to one another’ · also + gen., ’from, under the protection of’ (πρὸς Διός εἰσιν ’are from Zeus’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ῥαίοιτο πρὸς οὔδεϊ ’be dashed against the floor’) · also + dat., ’in addition to’ (πρὸς τοῖσί τε ὕπνος ’and sleep in addition to these’) · also + gen., of direction: ’toward, on the side of’ (πρὸς Βορέαο ’toward the North Wind’) · also + gen., in an appeal: ’by (your father)’ (πρὸς πατρὸς γουνάζομαι) · also as preverb in tmesis: με πρὸς μῦθον ἔειπε = με προσέειπε μῦθον ’spoke a word to me’ · also + gen., ’in the eyes of, with’ (πρὸς πόσιός τε καὶ υἱέος ’in the eyes of her husband and son’)
πρῶτον: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’first’
πόθι: πόθι — where?; interrog. adv. (Attic ποῦ), suffix -θι of place where
πόλλ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl., elided (πόλλ’ = πολλά): ’many’ · also used adverbially: ‘much, often’ (πόλλ’ ἐπέεσσιν ‘again and again with words’)
πόντῳ: πόντος — sea, open sea; dat. sg.
πόσις: πόσις — husband, spouse; masc. nom. sg. (distinct from πόσις ’drink’) · also πόσις — drink; fem. nom. sg. (βρῶσίς τε πόσις τε ’food and drink’)
σάμῃ: Σάμη — Same, an island near Ithaca; dat. sg.
σευ: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic enclitic (= Attic σοῦ): ’your, of you’
σπέος: σπέος — cave, grotto; neut. nom./acc. sg. (an irregular neuter noun declined σπέος, σπείους, etc.)
σπείρου: σπεῖρον — cloth, wrapping, winding-sheet; neut. gen. sg.
στῆσε: ἵστημι — set up, station, moor; aor. act. 3 sg., transitive (contrast intransitive ἕστασαν)
σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also as adverb, ’together’, or as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: σὺν … κάλυψε = συνεκάλυψε ’covered up’; σὺν … ἔπεσον = συνέπεσον ’fell together, clashed’ · also adverb ’along, with (us)’ construed with ἔχοντες, which takes the object (σὺν … χεῖρας ἔχοντες ’having hands along with us’)
σῷ: σός — your, yours; masc./neut. dat. sg.
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’ · also in a question, an expressive epic τε with no connective force, giving a note of doubt or wonder (πῶς τε ...; ’how, pray...?’) · also in ἦ τ’ (= ἦ τε), a strengthened affirmation: ’truly, surely’ (ἦ τ’ ἂν πολὺ κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would surely have been far better’) · also after a relative of size or amount, with no connective force: ὅσην τ’ ὄρεος κορυφήν ’as large as a mountain’s peak’ · also after ἤ ’than’, with no connective force: ἤ τ’ οἰωνοί ’than birds’
τέ: τε — and; enclitic connective, also marks a standing fact (epic τε) · also in the idiom ὅ τε (= ὅτι) ’in that, because’, giving a reason: ὅ τέ με … ἀποβῆναι ἀνώγει ’in that he bids me step off’ · also in ἦ τέ, a strengthened affirmation: ’truly’ (ἦ τέ μ’ ἔφαντο ’who truly said’)
τέτρατον: τέταρτος — fourth; epic by-form τέτρατος, neut. nom. sg. (agreeing with ἔτος)
τί: τίς, τί — who? what?; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially ’why’ · also the enclitic indefinite τις, τι ’someone, something’ (accented τί before an enclitic): neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with a negative, ’at all’ (οὔ τι) · adj. · also plain interrogative, direct object/predicate: ’what’ (τί πάθω ’what am I to suffer’; τί ... γένηται ’what is to become’) · also the enclitic indefinite as an adjective agreeing with a noun, accented before enclitic που: εἴ τί που εἴλυμα ’if any wrapper’ · also enclitic indefinite with a negative, ’anything’, as accusative subject of an infinitive (οὐ … τί φημι κακώτερον ἄλλο … συγχεῦαι ’I say nothing else is worse’) · also enclitic indefinite, adverbial without a negative: ’somehow, in some way’ (τοῦτό τί μοι κάλλιστον ’this seems to me somehow the fairest’) · also enclitic indefinite as an adjective after μή, accented before an enclitic: ’any’ (μή τί τοι … πῆμα ’any harm to you’) · also enclitic indefinite adjective after ὅπως, accented before enclitic μοι: ’any’ (τί … ἄλγος ’any pain’) · also enclitic indefinite adjective after ἤ, accented before the enclitic μοι: ’any’ (ἤ τί μοι … κειμήλιον ’or any treasure of mine’)
τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc. nom. sg. · also the enclitic indefinite τις accented before a following enclitic, not interrogative: ’someone, anyone’ (ἤν τίς τοι εἴπῃσι ’if someone tells you’)
τανηλεγέος: τανηλεγής — meaning unknown (traditionally ’laying at full length’ or ’bringing long sorrow’), epithet of death; masc./fem. gen. sg.
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τευ: τις, τι — someone, something; indefinite pron., masc./fem. gen. sg., epic τευ (= Attic τινός)
τεὸν: τεός (epic possessive = σός) — your, yours; masc./neut. acc. sg.
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., used adverbially with negatives ’at all’ · also adjectival indefinite: ’some, any’ (τι δήμιον ἄλλο ’some other public matter’) · also adverbial without a negative: ’in some way, in some measure’ (τι κατὰ πρῆξιν ’on some business’) · also as a substantive object, in a question: ’anything, something’ (ἦ ῥά τι ἴδμεν ’do we know anything’) · also the neut. of τις forming, with a preceding ὅ, the indefinite relative ὅ τι ’whatever, that which’ (αὔδα ὅ τι φρονέεις ’say whatever you have in mind’) · also ὅ τι as an adverbial acc. in an indirect question: ’why’ · also as a substantive object in a statement: ’something’ (καί τι ἴσασι ’they know something’)
τιν: τις, τι — someone, something; neut./masc. acc. sg., elided (τιν’ = τινα) · also fem. acc. sg. (εἴ τιν’ … λύσιν ’some release’)
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοκῆες: τοκεύς — parent, begetter (from τίκτω); nom. pl.
τοὶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. pl.: ’they’; also relative: ’who’ · also τοι, the affirming particle (ἀλλ’ ἦ τοι ’but truly’), as the grave-accented form τοὶ
τοῖς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: masc./neut. dat. pl. ’in which, with which’ (τετυγμένα, τοῖς ἐνάμελγεν ’well-made, in which he milked’) · also article-like with a noun, masc. dat. pl.: ’the’ (ἰχθύσι τοῖς ὀλίγοισι ’for the little fishes’)
τοῖσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’
τοῖσιν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’from/to them’
τρίετες: τρίετες — for three years; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially (acc. of duration), from τρίετης
τροίηνδε: Τροίη — Troy; adv. form with directional suffix -δε: ‘to Troy’
τρύχουσι: τρύχω — wear out, exhaust, consume; pres. 3 pl.
τόσα: τόσος — so much, so many; correlative demonstrative adj., neut. acc. pl.: ’so much’
τόσσον: τόσος (epic τόσσος) — so much, so great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’so much’
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’ · also in the adverbial idiom τὰ πρῶτα, ’at first, first’ (not ’these things’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’those, the’ (τὰ σὰ γούνατα ’those knees of yours’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: which; neut. nom. pl. (μῆλα, τὰ … κατάκειτ’ ’the flocks, which lie’) · also relative, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’, object of the verb in its clause (ῥωγαλέα, τὰ … ὅρηαι ’torn, which you see’) · also article-like with a substantivized adjective, neut.: ’the (worse things)’ (τὰ χέρεια)
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg. ’her’ · also ’it’, of a thing (τὴν = the clothing): fem. acc. sg. · also with a noun, article-like: τὴν ὁδόν ’that journey’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom; fem. acc. sg. (τὴν Ὠκεανὸς τέκε ’whom Oceanus begot’) · also ’the other’, contrasted with a preceding τὴν … μέν: fem. acc. sg. (τὴν δέ ’the other one’) · also article-like with a numeral: ’the one’ (τὴν μὲν ἴαν ’the one portion’)
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg. (τὸ πάροιθεν ’that which was before’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’that, the’ (τὸ σῆμα ’that mark’) · also article-like before the adverb πάρος: ’as before’ (ὡς τὸ πάρος περ) · also article-like before an ordinal, adverbial: τὸ τρίτον ’the third time’ · also distributive, neut. nom./acc. sg.: τὸ μὲν … τὸ δὲ ’one thing … another’ · also article-like before the adverb πρόσθεν: ’formerly’ (τὸ πρόσθεν ὄλοντο ’died long before’) · also article-like before a substantivized adjective, neut.: τὸ μέλαν ’the dark (part)’ · also article-like before the adverb πάροιθε: ’formerly’ (τὸ πάροιθε ’in former times’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. sg. (τὸν Ἀλφειὸς τέκε ’whom Alpheus begot’) · also demonstrative adjective with a noun: ’that, the’ (τὸν μῦθον ’that story, message’) · also demonstrative, distributive: masc. acc. sg. ’the one … the other’ (τὸν μὲν … τὸν δ’) · also article-like with a participle: τὸν ἐόντα ’me, the one who am’ · also article-like with a superlative or ordinal: ’the best’ (τὸν ἄριστον), ’the fourth’ (τὸν τέταρτον) · also article-like with a substantivized adjective: ’the like (one)’ (τὸν ὁμοῖον)
τῇ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. dat. sg.: ’her, with her’ · also adverbial, ’there, in that place’, pointing back to a place just named (τῇ τόν γε μένον λοχόωντες ’there they lay in wait for him’) · also relative, fem. dat. sg., serving as an instrumental, ’with which’ (ῥάβδον, τῇ τ’ ἀνδρῶν ὄμματα θέλγει ’a wand, with which he charms men’s eyes’), not the personal pronoun · also relative adv., ’where, in the place where’ (τῇ δή μοι ἐείσατο χῶρος ἄριστος) · also adverbial, ’in that (event)’, pointing back to a contest just named: τῇ δ’ αὖτ’ Εὐρύαλος ἀπεκαίνυτο ’in that Euryalus in turn outdid all’ · also relative adv. of manner, with περ: ’in just the way that’ · also adv. of direction, ’thither, that way’ · also with a noun, article-like: fem. dat. sg. ’the’ (τῇ δεκάτῃ ’on the tenth’) · also relative, fem. dat. sg., of respect or means: ’in which, by which’ (ἀγλαΐην, τῇ … κέκασσαι ’the beauty by which you excel’)
τῇσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic ταῖς): ’among them’
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc./neut. dat. sg.; also relative: ’in which’ · the relative dat. sg. also serves as an instrumental, ’with which’ (τῷ δάμνησι ’with which she overpowers’) · also adverbial ’therefore, and so’ (τῷ οὔ τινα οἶδα ’so I know no one’) · also article-like with a noun: ’that, the same’ (ἤματι τῷ αὐτῷ ’on that same day’) · also demonstrative instrumental, of a thing just named: ’with it’ (τῷ ἀπὸ πείσματ’ ἔκοψα ’with it I cut the cables off’) · also demonstrative of a thing just named, before a preposition: ’it’ (τῷ δ’ ἐν ’and on it’, τῷ δ’ ὑπό ’and beneath it’)
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own (with kin/body parts serves as a possessive); neut. nom./acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masculine noun: φίλον υἱόν ’dear son’ · also masc. acc. sg. predicative, agreeing with a pronoun: ’as a friend, welcome’ (φίλον ἐλθεῖν)
φθινόντων: φθίνω — waste away, wane, dwindle; pres. part. masc. gen. pl.: ’waning’
φρένας: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. acc. pl.
φρεσὶ: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. dat. pl.
φᾶρος: φᾶρος — large cloth, robe, web; neut. acc. sg.
χαλεπὸς: χαλεπός — harsh, hard to deal with; masc. nom. sg.
χρόνον: χρόνος — time; masc. acc. sg., acc. of duration
χρὴ: χρή — it is necessary, it is right; impersonal verb + acc. and inf. · also + acc. of the person and gen. of the thing: ’there is need of’
ἀέλλας: ἄελλα — blast, gust, squall; fem. acc. pl.
ἀγήνωρ: ἀγήνωρ — lordly, manly, proud; adj. (2-termination), masc./fem. nom. sg.
ἀθάνατοι: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. nom. pl.: ’the immortals’
ἀλώμενος: ἀλάομαι — wander; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
ἀμφιπολεύοι: ἀμφιπολεύω — attend, tend, look after; pres. opt. 3 sg. act., in a remote condition after εἰ: ’were to tend’
ἀμύμονος: ἀμύμων — blameless, excellent (an old epithet whose exact force is uncertain); gen. sg.
ἀνάγκης: ἀνάγκη — necessity, compulsion; fem. gen. sg.: ’under compulsion’
ἀνέμοιο: ἄνεμος — wind; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἀνείρεαι: ἀνείρομαι — ask, inquire; pres. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic -ῃ)
ἀνελθών: ἀνέρχομαι — go up, come up; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having gone up’
ἀπαμειβόμενος: ἀπαμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. nom. sg. masc.
ἀπείρονα: ἀπείρων — boundless, endless; fem. acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg. (the same form serves both genders for this adjective): ἀπείρονα πόντον ’boundless sea’
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’)
ἀργεῖοι: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀρετὴν: ἀρετή — excellence, worth; fem. acc. sg.
ἀχαιοί: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιούς: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. acc. pl.
ἀχαιϊάδων: Ἀχαιιάς — Achaean woman; fem. gen. pl.
ἄγων: ἄγω — lead, carry, bring; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’leading’
ἄκριτον: ἄκριτος — unending, ceaseless (literally ’undecided’); neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’endlessly’
ἄλγεα: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἄλλα: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἄλλη: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. nom. sg., adverbial in the idiom ἄλλυδις ἄλλη ’one this way, another that’ · also plain adj., fem. nom. sg.: ’other’ (οὔ τις ... ἄλλη ’no other woman’)
ἄλλην: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. acc. sg.
ἄλλοις: ἄλλος — other, another; masc./neut. dat. pl.
ἄλφιτα: ἄλφιτον — barley-groats, barley-meal (usu. pl.); neut. acc. pl.
ἄν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency (with subj. = future contingency, with opt. = potential) · also in ὄφρ’ ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that … may’ (ὄφρ’ ἄν ἔχῃς ’so that you may keep’)
ἄνακτα: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. acc. sg.
ἄνθρωποι: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; masc. nom. pl.
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, as it turned out, then; inferential particle
ἄριστοι: ἄριστος — best; superl., masc. nom. pl.
ἄστε: ἄστυ — city, town; neut. acc. pl., epic ἄστεα (= Attic ἄστη), elided (ἄστε’ = ἄστεα)
ἄστυδ: ἄστυ — town, city; acc. sg. + -δε of motion toward, elided (ἄστυδ’ = ἄστυδε): ’to the town’
ἄτερ: ἄτερ — without, apart from; prep. + gen.
ἄχομαι: ἄχομαι (ἄχνυμαι) — be grieved, sorrow, from ἄχος; pres. 1 sg. mid.: ’I grieve’
ἅμ: ἅμα (elided ἅμ’) — together with, at the same time as; adv./prep. + dat.
ἐγὼν: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., form used before a vowel
ἐθέλουσ: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., elided, concessive (ἐθέλουσ’ = ἐθέλουσα): ’though unwilling’
ἐκτελέσω: ἐκτελέω — finish completely, accomplish; aor. subj. 1 sg.
ἐκφυγέειν: ἐκφεύγω — flee from, escape; aor. inf., epic (= Attic ἐκφυγεῖν)
ἐλθὼν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having come’
ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’
ἐμοῖο: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
ἐμπάζομαι: ἐμπάζομαι — take heed of, pay attention to (+ gen.); pres. 1 sg.
ἐμὴν: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. acc. sg.
ἐμὸν: ἐμός — my, mine; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’my’ (ὄνομ’ … ἐμὸν ’my name’; ἐμὸν κῆρ ’my heart’)
ἐμὸς: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. nom. sg.
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐπ’ … χεῦε = ἐπέχευε ‘poured upon’) · also + dat., of time: ’in, within’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a day’) · also + acc., ’in pursuit of, after’ (ἐπ’ ἀγροτέρας ’after wild (goats)’) · also + dat., ’in favour of, on behalf of’ (ἐπ’ Ἴρῳ ἦρα φέρων ’showing favour to Irus’) · also + acc. of time: ’for’ (ἐπ’ ἦμαρ ’for a day’) · also + gen., of place: ’at, on’ (ἐπ’ ἐσχατιῆς ’at the edge’)
ἐπέεσσιν: ἔπος — word; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν)
ἐπέσσευεν: ἐπισεύω — drive on, hurl upon; aor. 3 sg. act., epic form with doubled σ (aor. ἔσσευα of σεύω): ’drove upon’
ἐπήλυθον: ἐπέρχομαι — come upon, come on, pass by; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἐπῆλθον)
ἐπειγόμενοι: ἐπείγομαι — press on, be eager for, hasten; pres. part. masc. nom. pl. mid., + acc.: ’eager for’
ἐπεπείθετο: πείθω — persuade; plpf. 3 sg. with impf. sense: ’was won over’
ἐπικρατέουσιν: ἐπικρατέω — hold power over, rule; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic -οῦσιν), + dat.
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’) · also + dat., ’beyond, over and above, more than’ (ἐπὶ γαστέρι κύντερον ’more shameless than the belly’) · also adverb of sequence, ’next, thereupon’ (ἦλθε δ’ ἐπὶ ψυχή ’and next came the soul’) · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: ἐπὶ … τέταλτο = ἐπιτέταλτο ’was laid upon, entrusted’ · also + acc. of time: ’for, over’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + dat., ’in charge of, over’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσιν ’over my possessions’) · also + dat., of purpose: ’for’ (ἐπὶ δόρπῳ ’for supper’) · also + dat., of the occasion: ’at, over’ (ἐπὶ ῥηθέντι δικαίῳ ’at a fair remark’)
ἐρέω: ἐρέω — say, tell, declare; fut. 1 sg. (epic fut. of εἶπον, = Attic ἐρῶ); in tmesis with ἐκ, ἐξερέω ’speak out plainly’
ἐσσί: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ)
ἐσσι: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ)
ἐτελέσθη: τελέω — bring to pass, accomplish, fulfil; aor. pass. 3 sg.: ’has been brought to pass’
ἐφάμην: φημί — say, speak; impf. mid. 1 sg., epic uncontracted: ’I was speaking, I spoke’ · also ’think, suppose’ with fut. inf.: ’I thought’ (οὐκ ἐφάμην ῥιγωσέμεν ’I did not think I should shiver’)
ἐόντων: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc./neut. gen. pl., epic (= Attic ὄντων): ’of (those) being’ (θεῶν αἰὲν ἐόντων ’of the gods who are forever’)
ἐῢ: ἐΰς — good; neut. ἐῢ as adv. ’well’ (= εὖ)
ἑνδεκάτη: ἑνδέκατος — eleventh; fem. nom. sg. (understanding ἡμέρα ’day’)
ἑτάροις: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); masc. dat. pl. (= Attic ἑταίροις)
ἔασιν: εἰμί — be; epic pres. 3 pl. (= Attic εἰσίν): ’are’
ἔθ: ἔτι — still, yet; adv., elided ἔθ’ before a rough breathing (with negative: ’no longer’)
ἔκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; prep. + gen., placed after its pronoun with anastrophe: τοῦ ... ἔκ = ἐκ τοῦ ’from him’ · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἔκ … ὀνόμαζε = ἐξωνόμαζε ’called by name’) · also prep. + gen. with a particle between it and its noun: ἔκ γε γυναικός ’at the hands of a woman’
ἔμεν: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic, shortened (= Attic εἶναι; cf. ἔμμεναι) · also μένω — stay, wait; impf. 3 sg., elided, augmented (ἔμεν’ = ἔμενε): ’he waited’
ἔμπεδα: ἔμπεδος — steadfast, secure, firm; neut. acc. pl.
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also used relatively, continuing a clause: ’where’ (ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’) · also doubled, ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα ’this way and that’
ἔπειθον: πείθω — persuade; impf. 3 pl. (the ending also serves 1 sg.): ’they tried to persuade’
ἔστι: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg. impersonal: ’it is possible’ · also existential, ‘there is’ (ἔστι δέ τις πέτρη ‘there is a rock’)
ἔφασκε: φημί — say, promise; impf. 3 sg., iterative -σκ-: ’kept saying, kept promising’
ἔχομαι: ἔχω — hold; mid./pass. ἔχομαι, be held, be gripped by (+ dat.); pres. 1 sg.: ’I am beset’
ἠματίη: ἠμάτιος — by day, in the daytime; fem. nom. sg. used adverbially
ἠμείβετ: ἀμείβω — exchange; mid. answer, reply; impf. 3 sg. mid. (ἠμείβετο, elided ἠμείβετ’)
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ) · also introducing the first alternative of a question: ’whether’ (ἠὲ διεπράθετο … ἦ … ’whether it was sacked … or …’) · also ’than’, after a word of difference (ἀλλοῖος … ἠὲ πάροιθεν ’different than before’) · also ’than’ after a comparative or word of preference (βέλτερόν ἐστι … ἠὲ ’it is better … than’) · also introducing the first alternative of a command: ’either’ (ἠὲ σὺ πρῶτος ἔσελθε ’either you go in first’)
ἠὼς: Ἠώς — Dawn; fem. nom. sg. · also a common noun, ’morning’ (ὄφρα μὲν ἠὼς ἦν ’as long as it was morning’)
ἡ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. nom. sg.: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. ’it’, of a pool of water (ἡ δὲ προσέπλαζε ’and it lapped up’) · also fem. nom. sg. ’it’, of a ship (ἡ δ’ ἔθει ’and it ran’) · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun/adj., article-like: ’the other’ (ἡ δ’ ἄλλη ’and the other woman’) · also fem. nom. sg. article-like with a noun: ’the’ (ἡ γὰρ δμώων δίκη ’for the way of servants’)
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj. (epic ἠέ/ἤ) · also ’than’ after a comparative: κρεῖσσον … ἢ ὅτε ’better than when’ · also ’before’ after a verb of anticipating (ἔφθης … ἢ ἐγώ ’you got here before I did’) · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἔτι … ἦέ τις ’whether still … or someone’) · also ’than’ after a verb of preferring: βουλοίμην … ἢ … ἀνάσσειν ’I would rather … than rule’ · also introducing the first alternative of a deliberation: ’whether … or’ (ἢ ἐλάσει’ … ἦέ μιν ἦκ’ ἐλάσειε)
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἤματα: ἦμαρ — day; neut. acc. pl., acc. of time: ’all the days, every day’ · also neut. nom. pl., subject: ’the days’ (νύκτες τε καὶ ἤματα φθίνουσιν)
ἦ: ἦ — truly, verily; affirming particle · also interrogative particle introducing an earnest question · also = ἤ ’or’, in the correlative ἠέ … ἦ ’whether … or’ · also ἠμί — say, speak; unaugmented aor./impf. 3 sg. (= ἔφη), closing or introducing direct speech: ’he/she said’ (ἦ ῥα ’so he said’) · also ’or’, the second alternative of a pair of questions with no preceding ἠέ: ζώει … ἦ τέθνηκε ’alive or dead’; ἢ ἔτ’ ἔχει … ἦ μιν ἀτιμάζουσιν ’whether … or’
ἦλθεν: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’came’
ἧς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. gen. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whose, of whom/which (fem. gen. sg.)
ἧσθαι: ἧμαι — sit, be seated; pres. inf.: ’to sit’ (subject of ἔοικε, with an accusative subject of its own)
ἰδομενῆα: Ἰδομενεύς — Idomeneus, leader of the Cretans; masc. acc. sg., epic -ῆα (= Attic -έα)
ἰδόμην: ὁράω — see; aor. mid. 1 sg., unaugmented: ’I saw’
ἰθάκην: Ἰθάκη — Ithaca, Odysseus’ island home; acc. sg.
ἱέμενον: ἵεμαι — long for, be eager; pres. part. mid., masc. acc. sg., + gen.: ’(you) eager for (your return)’
ἱκετάων: ἱκέτης — suppliant; masc. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
ἱστόν: ἱστός — loom; masc. acc. sg. · also ’mast’ (of a ship), a distinct sense required by nautical context (ἐν δ’ ἱστόν τ’ ἐτίθεντο ’they set the mast in it’)
ἲς: ἴς (gen. ἰνός) — force, strength, might; fem. nom. sg., in the periphrasis ἱερὴ ἲς + gen. ’the sacred strength of ...’, i.e. the hero himself · also plain ’force, might’ of a thing: ἲς ἀνέμοιο ’the force of the wind’
ἴλιον: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. acc. sg.
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; + subj. · also + opt. after a past tense · also relative ’where’ + indic.: ἵνα … καθεύδετον ’where the two are sleeping’ · also + opt. after a future main verb: ’so that … may’ (ἄξω … ἵνα … ἄλφοι ’I will take … so that he may bring in’)
ὀδυνάων: ὀδύνη — pain, ache, anguish; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
ὀδυσσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
ὀδυσῆ: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. acc. sg. Ὀδυσῆα, elided (Ὀδυσῆ’ = Ὀδυσῆα)
ὀδυσῆα: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; acc. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆα)
ὀδυσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; gen. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆος)
ὀλοὴ: ὀλοός — deadly, destructive; fem. nom. sg.
ὀπάζει: ὀπάζω — bestow, grant, give as a follower; pres. 3 sg.
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg. · also article-like with an adjective and a name: ’the’ (ὁ θρασὺς Ὀδυσσεύς ’bold Odysseus’) · also article-like with a noun: ’the’ (ὁ γέρων ’the old man’) · also distributive, masc. nom. sg.: ’the one’ (ὁ μὲν οὐρανὸν εὐρὺν ἱκάνει ’the one reaches the broad heaven’) · also article-like with a superlative: ’the worst’ (ὁ κάκιστος Ἀχαιῶν ’the worst of the Achaeans’)
ὁππόθεν: ὁππόθεν — from where; epic indirect interrog. adv. (= Attic πόθεν)
ὁππότε: ὁππότε (Attic ὁπότε) — whenever, when; conj., + subj. and κε in a general temporal clause · also introducing an indirect question, + pres. indic.: ’when’ (ὁππότε Τηλέμαχος νεῖτ(αι) ’when Telemachus is to return’) · also + subj. without κε, in a general clause: ’whenever’ (ὁππότε τις μνήσῃ ’whenever anyone mentions’) · also + opt., of what may happen in time to come: ’whenever he should’ (ὁππότε νοστήσειε ’whenever he should come home’) · also + indic., of a recurring case: ’whenever’ (ὁππότε θυμὸς ἄνωγε ’whenever the heart bids’)
ὄληται: ὄλλυμαι — perish, be lost, be destroyed; aor. subj. 3 sg. mid. (μή + subj.: ’lest … perish’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’when … perishes’ (ἐπὴν … ὄληται) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὅπως: ’so that … may perish’
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg.; with γε: ’he’ · also relative, masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’who’ (ὅ κε ... ἐφείη) · also = ὅτι ’that’; εἰς ὅ ’until’ · also relative, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’which’ (ὅ οἱ πέρι δῶκεν Ἀθήνη ’which Athena gave her beyond others’) · also masc. nom. sg. pronoun ’he’ without γε, accented before an enclitic (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’)
ὅθι: ὅθι — where; epic relative adverb (= Attic οὗ)
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also with τις, an indirect interrogative: οὐκ οἶδ’ ὅς τις ’I know not who’ · also with τις, indefinite relative: ὅς τις … φάγοι ’whoever should eat’
ὅσσοι: ὅσος — as much/many as; epic ὅσσος, masc. nom. pl.: ’as many as’ (correlative with τόσσοι)
ὅσσον: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος) — as much/great as; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, correlative with τόσσον: ’as far as’ · also in an indirect exclamation, ’how greatly’ (ὅσσον ἄρισται ’how excellent they are’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λαόν, in an indirect exclamation: ’how great (a host)’
ὅτε: ὅτε — when; temporal conjunction · also ’since, now that’ (ὅτε πρότερός γε πύθοιτο ’since he learned of it first’) · also with the optative, hypothetical/conditional: ’if ever, whenever’ (ὅτε ... ἵκοι ’if ever such need should come upon me’) · also with the subjunctive, general: ’whenever’ (ὅτε στείχῃσ’ ἀνὰ ἄστυ ’whenever she goes through the town’) · also with the optative, iterative in past time: ’whenever’ (ὅτε μέλλοι ’whenever he was about to’) · also with the pres. indic., ’whereas, when’ (ὅτε τ’ ἄλλοι ἅπαξ θνῄσκουσ’ ἄνθρωποι ’whereas other men die only once’) · also in ὅτε μή, ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ θεὸς … θείη ’unless a god should make’)
ὑλήεντι: ὑλήεις — wooded (from ὕλη); masc./neut. dat. sg.
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; prep. + gen.; also + acc., ’under, up under’ · also of agent with a verb of dying, ‘by, at the hands of’ + gen. (ὤλεθ’ ὑπ’ Αἰγίσθοιο ‘perished by Aegisthus’) · also + dat., ’under, beneath’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb, no case governed: οὓς ὑπ’ Ὀδυσσεὺς δύσετ’ = ὑπεδύσετο ’underneath which Odysseus sank down’
ὑπάλυξεν: ὑπαλύσκω — slip away from, escape; aor. 3 sg.: ’slipped away, got clear away’
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’
ὤλεσαν: ὄλλυμι — destroy, ruin; aor. 3 pl. act.
ὤρορε: ὄρνυμι — rouse, stir up; aor. 2 3 sg., reduplicated, used without an object; the exact sense is uncertain
ὥς: ὥς — thus, so; also (with κε/ἄν + subj.) ’so that, in order that’; adverb/conjunction · also introducing an indirect question: ’how’ (ὥς κε νέηται ’how he is to return’, after φράσσεται) · or ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic τε · also causal, ’since, seeing that’ (ὥς οἱ ἐναργὲς ὄνειρον ἐπέσσυτο ’since a vivid dream had come upon her’) · also with κεν + opt., purpose: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’) · also ὥς ’just as’, in ὥς περ (accented before enclitic περ) (ὥς περ ὑπέστης ’just as you promised’) · also ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic με (ὥς με κελεύεις ’as you bid me’) · also postpositive after its noun, comparative ’like’ (οἰωνῶν ὥς ’like birds’) · also ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic τοι (ὥς τοι ἐγὼν ἐρέω ’as I shall tell you’) · also correlative ’so’ answering ὅπως, introducing a wish with the opt., accented before the enclitic τοι: ’so may’ (ὥς τοι Ζεὺς τελέσειεν ’so may Zeus fulfil it for you’) · also with a plain subj. (no κε/ἄν), purpose: ’so that’ (ὥς τοι δῶρ’ ἀποπέμψω ’so that I may send you the gifts’) · also ὥς accented before enclitic οἱ, of measure: ’as much as’ (ὥς οἱ χεῖρες ἐχάνδανον ’as much as his hands could hold’) · also exclamatory, ’how’, accented before the enclitic τις (ὥς τις θαρσαλέος … ἐσσι ’how bold you are’) · also with the plain optative (no κε/ἄν), purpose, accented before the enclitic μιν: ’so that’ (ὥς μιν ψυχὴ λίποι ’so that life should leave him’)
ὧραι: ὥρα — season, time of year; fem. nom. pl.
ᾖεν: εἶμι — go; impf. 3 sg., epic ᾖεν, ν-movable (= Attic ᾔει): ’went’
ᾤχεθ: οἴχομαι — go, be gone; impf. 3 sg., augmented ᾤ-, elided with τ > θ before a rough breathing (ᾤχεθ’ = ᾤχετο): ’he went off’
